author: Edward Easton
title: Texas death row killer ate own eye after murdering ex-wife and children - NewsBreak
text:
By Edward Easton Jane Lavender ,
35 minutes ago There are certain crimes so horrific and so wicked they send shockwaves through an entire nation.
That is undoubtedly true of Andre Thomas, who killed his ex-wife Laura Boren and her two young children, before mutilating their bodies in a crime he insisted was commanded by God.
• Gruesome final moments of Hollywood legend and child star decapitated in on-set horror
• Model wife killed, castrated and cooked husband before eating him with BBQ sauce
In March 2004, a frenzied Thomas broke into Boren's apartment, stabbing her to death before cutting open her chest and extracting her heart.
Tragically, he would then carry out the same horrific mutilation and murderous rampage on her two young children, before stabbing himself.
After this violent rampage, the deranged killer then casually walked to the local police station, turned himself in and informed officers present he had been commanded to 'destroy demons' by a divine influence.
If that wasn't disturbing enough, Thomas would subsequently gouge out both of his own eyes, in what lawyers characterized as a desperate attempt to avoid prosecution, reports the Mirror .
He gouged out his first eye, the right, with his bare hands while awaiting trial in a Texas jail. According to court documents at the time, he cited a Bible verse about gouging out an eye that causes sin.
Despite being diagnosed schizophrenia by a team of psychiatrists and therefore pleading insanity, a jury convicted him and he was sentenced to death.
Addressing the court at the time, the judge noted the uniqueness of the crime, stating: "This is a sad case. Applicant is clearly "crazy", but he is also "sane" under Texas law."
During his time on death row , Thomas gouged out his remaining eye and ate it, an act his own defence team believed he carried out in an attempt to prevent the government from monitoring his thoughts.
He was moved to a secure psychiatric facility within the Texas prison system, though his death sentence stayed in force.
His situation has since sparked controversy regarding the execution of prisoners with profound mental illness, with his legal representatives contending that he is not mentally fit for execution as he cannot rationally comprehend why the state intends to end his life.
Subsequently, in 2023, a judge decided to postpone his planned execution to permit additional evaluation of his psychiatric state.
Thomas continues to be on death row, sightless and held in a unit for inmates with severe psychiatric conditions.
